title: fr.linagora.twalk.inbound.presence.updated.v1
description: A contact came online, went offline or became unavailable on an external messaging network, observed by the Sensor from bridge presence traffic in a Matrix portal room and normalized as a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope. Matrix presence is ephemeral (EDU): it carries no event ID, so the deterministic id derives from the sender, the state and the receipt timestamp. Consumed by Hermes personas subscribed to the inbound.presence.updated.* subject on NATS JetStream.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Fixed to 1.0 for all Twalk v1 events.

id.description: Deterministic identifier computed as sha256(matrix_user_id + ':' + presence + ':' + receipt_timestamp_ms), where receipt_timestamp_ms is the homeserver receipt time of the presence update in milliseconds. Presence EDUs carry no Matrix event ID; this natural key keeps bus resynchronizations idempotent.

source.description: URI identifying one Matrix portal room the subject shares with the Sensor. Format: matrix://<homeserver>/<room_id>. Matrix presence is NOT room-scoped — the update is a fact about an account and arrives with no room attached — so this names a room the subject is observed in and never the room 'the presence happened in'. The Sensor names the first, in room-id order, of the rooms that resolve to the network already decided from the subject's own identity: an ordering may break a tie between rooms that agree, and never decides the network (see ADR 0027).

type.description: CloudEvents type. Reverse-DNS convention with an explicit version suffix. Any breaking change to this schema requires incrementing the suffix (v2, v3, ...) rather than mutating v1.

time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the Sensor produced the event.

subject.description: Matrix user ID of the contact whose presence changed, as materialized by the bridge. Used for routing and for consent evaluation. Always a person the bridge stands in for — a ghost, or a native Matrix account (ADR 0009) — and never the deployment owner (ADR 0021) nor a bridge's own bot, the appservice service identity named by its sender_localpart (ADR 0026): neither is a contact, neither has a consent state, and nothing is published about a bridge bot on any type.

datacontenttype.description: Fixed to application/json for all Twalk v1 events.

dataschema.description: Optional URI pointing back to this JSON Schema. Recommended for third-party consumers that validate events dynamically.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header. Enables distributed tracing across Sensor, NATS, Hermes and downstream services without mandating a specific tracing backend.

network.description: Twalk extension. Identifies the network the SUBJECT is on, as the user experiences it; transport bridges (e.g. mautrix-gmessages) are never network values. Unlike every other event type, this one is not about traffic in a room, so the value is derived from something that identifies the subject — a bridge ghost's localpart, or the fact that they share a room no bridge marked — and never from an ordering over the rooms they happen to be in (ADR 0027). The value matrix is a native Matrix account, reached through the user's own homeserver instead of through a bridge (ADR 0009); a native Matrix contact who is also a member of a bridged portal room is still matrix, because that membership is an invitation and not an identity on that network. A subject the Sensor cannot attribute to exactly one network produces no event at all rather than an event under a guessed network, since consent is looked up by (subject, network).

consent.description: Twalk extension. Current consent state of the contact's data-processing agreement, as tracked by the Companion Gateway, the single writer of consent state. Personas MUST refuse to process events where consent is not 'granted', unless they are explicitly authorized to handle consent-management workflows.

presence.description: The new presence state of the contact, normalized across networks.

last_active_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of when the contact was last active, when the bridge reports it.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name of the contact, as known to the recipient.

network_identifier.description: Optional native network identifier (e.g. phone number for WhatsApp, username for Telegram). Only populated when consent state allows it.

avatar_mxc_uri.description: Optional Matrix content URI for the contact's avatar.

contact.description: Structured information about the contact, resolved by Sensor from the Matrix membership state and bridge metadata.
